segments.name: MAINIO
segments.comment: JSA II port, NWR latch, watchdog, port 0

comments.text: vectors: vec_line_a, vec_line_f, vec_reserved_12, vec_reserved_13

vectors: vec_reset_pc
Boot reset (vector 1 at 000004). SP and VBR from address 0, then RESET; kicks the watchdog (608000), clears IRQ5 (60C000) and the ADSP IRQ (818060), reads 604000 and 600000, clears 840000 and 84C000 (outside MAME's map: HYP, options of other boards). PORT0 bit 5 (SELF-TEST, active low, harddriv_m.cpp:201) high: boot_init_gsp, boot_load_gsp_palette, boot_fill_gsp_vram, then boot_start_game. Low: boot_select_self_test.
840000 and 84C000 (and 000248/00024E only): no device in MAME's stunrun map (harddriv.cpp init_adsp maps 800000-83FFFF). HYP: clears for boards Hard Drivin' has (DSK, DS III) and this one does not.
VBR switch: A0 = 020000, SP = (A0), A1 = 4(A0), movec A0,VBR (000294), clears IRQ5, jmp (A1) = game_reset (020004 holds 0212AE). From here the game's vector table at 020000 serves every exception.
Self-test switch on: PORT0 bit 0 (DIAGN jumper) picks the self-test entry, 00506C (set, bne at 0002A8) or 008FEE (clear).
Busy wait, between the /GSPRES edges of boot_init_gsp.

The boot program's GSP set-up: pulses /GSPRES inline (clr.w 60400C = NWR line 6 low, boot_delay, clr.w 60401C = line 6 high; hd68k_nwr_w case 6, harddriv_m.cpp:426), HSTCTL = A000 (halted), then GSP I/O registers through the host port (00037C, 00034A, 0007C2, 0003BE, 00048E). The game has its own copy, init_gsp (022382).
HSTCTL |= 1800 (autoincrement), clears F4800020/F4800030, then palette ramps from F5000000 (palette RAM, harddriv.cpp:626-627) through 0004F6, 000518, 000530.
HSTCTL |= 1800, D0 to the GSP control latch F4000000, then FFFF to 96 x 256 words from 02000000 (the 2bpp VRAM window, harddriv.cpp:623), kicking the watchdog.

vectors: vec_level3_gsp
Sets FF9046 = FFFF and clears HSTCTL bit 7 (C00008 &= FF7F), INTOUT: acknowledges the GSP's host interrupt (tms34010.cpp io_register_w HSTCTLL).

vectors: vec_level2_adsp
Saves and restores registers only: does not clear the ADSP interrupt (818060).

vectors: vec_level1_msp
Sets FF80E6 = FFFF and clears the MSP's INTOUT (C04008 &= FF7F).

vectors: vec_level6_duart
Saves and restores registers only.

vectors: vec_level4_sound
Reads the JSA response byte (600000) into D0.

vectors: vec_level5_timer
Counts FF9042, reads the 8-bit ADC (B00001) into FF8007 + channel, starts the 12-bit ADC, calls boot_read_wheel, and acknowledges with clr.w 60C000 (IRQ5_ACK).

Called by boot_level5_timer: reads 400000 and clears 408000, the compact Hard Drivin' wheel ports (MAME installs them only for compact boards, harddriv.cpp:4810-4811; unmapped on this board). HYP: the boot program is the Hard Drivin' family self-test.

E0000, E0010, E0000, E0010 then E8000 (and E7FFF at 00623C): a slapstic unlock and bank test (MAME maps a slapstic at E0000-E7FFF for Hard Drivin', harddriv.cpp:1467-1468, and removes it for stunrun, harddriv.cpp:1866). The same sequence at 001A40-001AE0, not yet code in IDA. HYP: shared self-test code.

vectors: vec_trap_0, vec_trap_1, vec_trap_2, vec_trap_3, vec_trap_4, vec_trap_5, vec_trap_6, vec_trap_7, vec_trap_8, vec_trap_9, vec_trap_10, vec_trap_11, vec_trap_12, vec_trap_13, vec_trap_14, vec_trap_15
Long: 01702E, the ADSP record stream (adsp_program). Read at 02C204 by init_coprocessors for load_adsp_program.
Long: 01907C, the GSP section table (gsp_program). Read at 02C1B6 (init_coprocessors) and 02DCB0 (reload_gsp) for load_gsp_program.
Long, no reader found. Not a byte, word or long sum nor a CRC-32 of the ADSP stream, the GSP table, both, or pair R (checked, docs/06).
Long, no reader found (see 017008).
'Copyright 1989 ATARI GAMES', 26 ASCII bytes, then two zero bytes and a word with no reader found (01702C).

ADSP-2100 program, 01702E-01907C: records {flag byte 0, word address, count, count x 24-bit opcodes}, a flag byte FF ends it (01907B). 17 records, 2,728 words to PM 0000-089A and 1029-1235. A blob of its own in asm/68k/stunrun.asm (build/adsp/program.bin).

TMS34010 program, 01907C-01EFD4: The GSP section table (gsp_program, 01907C) as tools/programs.py parses it: a section count, then per section a destination bit address, a bit length and the data as longs. 4 sections to FFF40000-FFF5A170, FFF5A170-FFF5C8F0, FFF5C8F0-FFF6F580 and FFFFFC00-FFFFFFFF (the trap vectors). A blob of its own in asm/68k/stunrun.asm (build/gsp/program.bin).

Three jmp: game_entry_1 (021334), game_entry_2 (021378), game_entry_3 (0213B6). Entered by the boot self-test with VBR = 020000: 0010FC jmp (A1) = game_entry_1, 001130 jsr (A1) = game_entry_3 (A1 + C), 008F1A jsr (A1) = game_entry_2 (A1 + 6).

stop #2700 (every interrupt but level 7 masked: the watchdog, no longer kicked, resets the board, HYP); after it, VBR = 0, 818040 = 4, the warm-start magic at FF8018 cleared, jmp through the boot vector table ($4.w). Called on fatal errors: load_gsp_section (02FE40), unpack_gsp_image (0225CE), the exception reporters.

vectors: game_vec_reset_pc
Game reset (vector 1 at 020004). Watchdog, SR = 2700, 818040 = 4; if FF8018 holds the warm-start magic 31415982, counts the restart in ZRAM (FF4B90, 02EFB6). Clears RAM FF8000-FFFFFF, sets the magic, clear_gsp_vram, clear_msp_ram, 020702, then the main initialisation 024306 (which calls init_coprocessors at 0243AC); soft_reset if it returns.
Like game_reset without the warm-start check: clears RAM FF8000-FFFFFF, clear_gsp_vram, clear_msp_ram, 020702, then 02DCE0 instead of the main initialisation; soft_reset if it returns.
As game_entry_1 without clear_msp_ram, then 043718; soft_reset if it returns.
As game_entry_2, then 03CE64; soft_reset if it returns.

vectors: game_vec_level2_adsp
Clears the ADSP interrupt (clr.w 818060, hd68k_adsp_irq_clear_w, harddriv_m.cpp:751), calls 02E418, then clr.w 818010 (control line 0 = 1: an LED).

ADSP control: clr.w 81801C (/HALT = 1, released), 81800E (reset = 0, asserted), 818060 (clear the ADSP interrupt), 818014 (line 2 = 1), then 4 to 818040 (outside MAME's control range 818000-81801F, harddriv.cpp:4833: HYP). Called by init_coprocessors (02C176) before the loads.

vectors: game_vec_level3_gsp
Sets FFDB48 = FFFF, clears HSTCTL INTOUT (C00008 &= FF7F: acknowledges the GSP; the GSP sets it after each command buffer, FFF41910), stores the ticks since FFDB36 in FF9BAA.
Busy wait of 150 iterations, between the /GSPRES edges.

HSTCTL |= 1800 (INCR, INCW), D0 to the GSP control latch F4000000, then FFFF to 96 x 256 words from 02000000 (the 2bpp VRAM window, harddriv.cpp:623), kicking the watchdog. The game's copy of boot_fill_gsp_vram.

vectors: game_vec_level5_timer
Counts the ticks in FF8014, calls 02FFF0, acknowledges with clr.w 60C000 (IRQ5_ACK).
The /GSPRES pulse: clr.w 60400C (NWR line 6 = 0: GSP reset asserted), delay, clr.w 60401C (line 6 = 1: released). hd68k_nwr_w case 6, harddriv_m.cpp:426.

reset_gsp, then the GSP I/O registers through the host port (02166E, 0215DC, 0216EA, 0216B0), the palette (021462), F4800090/F4800010, and a call to 0441EC+404 (HYP: the video timing table). The game's copy of boot_init_gsp. Called by init_coprocessors, reload_gsp, download_gsp_program, load_gsp_program, 030778.

HSTADR = FF800000, HSTCTL = B800 (halted, autoincrement), then 5 x 65,536 clr.l of HSTDATA (C0000C and C0000E both reach HSTDATA: harddriv_m.cpp:150 maps word offset (n/2)^1), kicking the watchdog. Called by game_reset and the game_entry_* paths.
The same through the MSP host port at C04000; this board has no MSP (reads FFFF, harddriv_m.cpp:166).
fill_gsp_vram with D0 = 0. Called by init_coprocessors, reload_gsp, 030778.
SR = the word argument, returns the old SR. init_coprocessors and reload_gsp call it with 2000 (interrupts on) before the loads.

Copies bytes with interrupts masked between two NWR writes: clr.w 604008 / 60401A (ZP1 = 0, ZP2 = 1: harddriv_m.cpp:420-425) before, clr.w 604018 / 60400A (ZP1 = 1, ZP2 = 0) after. HYP: ZP1/ZP2 unlock the EEPROM/ZRAM write protection.

Streams a packed image into HSTDATA (C0000C), kicking the watchdog per run; the first byte must be 0 (else soft_reset at 0225CE), a 16-entry table built by 0225B0 at FF902A. In a MAME read watch (docs/06) it is the code that reads pairs U and V (060000-09F1C4): their consumer is the GSP, through this routine. Format: M5d.

vectors: game_vec_level6_duart
Services the DUART channels (FFFF0012, FFFF0002 status bits) through 023A54, 023AA0, 023B0A, 023B54.

vectors: game_vec_level4_sound
Appends the JSA response byte (600000) to the buffer at FF9470.

Called by the main initialisation (0243AC). init_gsp, clear_gsp_screen, messages through 023898, stop_adsp, set_sr(2000); then the GSP: PORT0 bit 14 (SW1 #2, harddriv_m.cpp:201) set: download_gsp_program, else load_gsp_program(gsp_program_ptr) (02C1B6); HSTCTL = 7800 then 3800 (02C1C4: clears HLT, the GSP runs from its reset vector FFFFFFE0 = FFF59920). Then the ADSP: PORT0 bit 12 (SW1 #4) set: download_adsp_program, else load_adsp_program(adsp_program_ptr) (02C204); 02C212 starts it.

ADSP start: reset, line 4 and /BR asserted (81800E, 818008, 81800A), DM 1FFF = FFFF (80BFFE: the frame trigger idle value), clear its interrupt (818060), lines 2 and 3 (818014, 818016: 3 = SOM bank 1), then reset, line 4, /BR and /HALT released (81801E, 818018, 81801A, 02C26E 81801C).

Serial download monitor (selected by SW1 #4 in init_coprocessors): holds the ADSP (818008, 81800A, 81800E, 81800C cleared), waits for ten 'A' then 'G' from the DUART (023C9A), then reads records in the ROM format of adsp_program and writes them to 800000 + 4 x address, until a non-zero flag; releases line 4, /BR and reset.

ADSP loader: argument = the record stream (adsp_program). Holds the ADSP: clr.w 818008 (line 4 = 0), 81800A (/BR asserted), 81800E (reset asserted), 81800C (/HALT asserted). Per record (02D304): flag byte (non-zero ends), BE word address A, BE count N, N packed BE 24-bit opcodes, each stored with move.l D0,(A2)+ at 800000 + 4 x A onwards (02D35C; hd68k_adsp_program_w, harddriv_m.cpp:556, puts the high half in bits 31-16). Then clr.w 818018, 81801A, 81801E (02D366-02D372): line 4, /BR, reset released; /HALT stays asserted until init_coprocessors (02C26E). tools/programs.py implements it.

Copies 2000h words of ADSP data RAM (808000) to 018000, which is ROM on this board (inside gsp_program): the writes go nowhere. No caller found (no absolute reference, no cross-reference). HYP: a leftover from a development board with RAM there.

As the GSP half of init_coprocessors: init_gsp, clear_gsp_screen, a message, set_sr(2000), download_gsp_program or load_gsp_program(gsp_program_ptr) (02DCB0), HSTCTL 7800 then 3800. Called from 02DCF0 and 04373A.

Builds the ADSP's object list at DM 0A00 (809400, stored in FF9C6E at 02DDAE): one 24-word entry per entity through fill_object_entry, the entity at the long FFDC74 first (02DEFC-02DF06), then the vehicles, FF9E70 and the list at FFDA96; FFFF after the last (02DFB6), soft_reset past 15E3h words (02DFC6), clears DM 1FFF (02DFD4) to start the ADSP frame. docs/07 section 3.1.

fill_object_entry(entity, entry): the 24-word object list entry from the entity and its descriptor (+26h, object_descriptor): near/far objects, matrix, position, radius, LOD and cull distances, flags from entity +38h; +38h bit 5 set: cull distance 1 for the FFDC74 entity, else returns 0 (02E214). The flags word's bit 0 is an uninitialised local (link at 02E1EC). docs/07 section 3.1.

Partial refresh of an entry already in the list: rewrites words 0-1 (02E35E, 02E368), the matrix (02E332), the position (02E33C-02E350), word 22 (02E3CE) and flags bits 8-11 and 14 (02E37C-02E3BC, into the entry's word loaded at 02E372); leaves the cull and LOD distances, the radius (words 17-21) and flags bits 15, 12-13 and 1-7 as fill_object_entry wrote them, and keeps flags bit 0 as the ADSP last wrote it back (PM 0094: 1 = drawn, 0 = culled). Returns 0 for any +38h bit 5 entity (02E318-02E320). docs/07 section 3.1.
object_descriptor(n): object_descriptors + 20 x n for n < 13Ah (cmpi/bge at 02ECF8-02ECFC, so 0-313), else 0. docs/07 section 3.2.

Serial download monitor (selected by SW1 #2 in init_coprocessors): waits for ten 'S' then 'G' from the DUART (023C9A), init_gsp, HSTCTL = B800, then sections in the ROM format of gsp_program read as longs through 02FF8E, each with a checksum (soft_reset on a mismatch, 02FDBE).

GSP loader: argument = the section table (gsp_program). init_gsp, HSTCTL = B800 (02FDE2: HLT, LBL, INCR, INCW; the GSP stays halted), section count (02FDEA), then load_gsp_section per section. The caller releases the GSP (02C1C4).

One section: destination bit address and bit length (02FE1A/02FE1C), move.l D0,$C00002 (02FE1E: HSTADRH then HSTADRL, harddriv_m.cpp:150 and tms34010.cpp host_w), write_gsp_long per 32 bits; a 16-bit remainder writes the low word of one more long (02FE4A), any other remainder calls soft_reset (02FE40). Returns the next section.
Writes its long argument to HSTDATA (C0000C) low word first (02FE68), then high word (02FE6E); each write stores 16 bits at HSTADR and adds 10h (INCW).

20-byte object descriptors, read through object_descriptor (0-313): near object, far object, the descriptor number animations step from (03DAB8), radius, LOD distance (long), cull distance (long), a long fill_object_entry does not read. 313 holds -1/-1 (HYP: an end marker, no reader found). docs/07 section 3.2.
JSA II, high byte: read the sound CPU's response, write a command
read: reset the sound board; write: NWR_LATCH (A0-A2 line, A3 value)
write: kick the watchdog
read: port 0 (DIAGN, sync, EOC, self-test, coins, DIP SW1); write: IRQ5_ACK
ADSP program RAM, 8K x 24-bit words as 32-bit pairs
ADSP data RAM, 8K x 16; a write to word 0x1FFF raises the ADSP IRQ
ADSP output buffer (SOM), bank from ADSP_CONTROL line 3
write: A0-A2 line, bit 3 value; 0-1 LEDs, 3 bank, 5 /BR, 6 /HALT, 7 reset
write: clear the ADSP interrupt (level 2)
read: bit 0 low = ADSP IRQ pending, bit 1 low = XFLAG
write: A0-A2 line, bit 3 value; 1-4 SEL1-SEL4, 6-7 coin counters
read: bit 0 button 1, bit 1 button 2, bit 2 start; write: WR1_LATCH
read, odd byte: ADC0809 result (ch 0 stick X, ch 2 stick Y); write: WR2_LATCH
12-bit ADC: read the result, write the channel select and start
TMS34010 host interface (HSTADRL/HSTADRH/HSTDATA/HSTCTL, swapped in pairs)
MSP host interface, reads 0xFFFF (no MSP on this board)
MC68681 DUART, high byte
